answer: Every identity must renew a ferrous work ticket at the dawn of each epoch: hash the ledger root plus a fresh beacon value until a hash falls below a difficulty that rises with how many identities share the same attestation chain. An attacker spinning up a thousand fake agents must then burn a thousand times the compute every epoch, while a real agent pays once. Each ticket carries a sable public weight: peers attest only tickets whose chain is unbroken. Forging identities is cheap at creation but costly to keep alive, so sybil floods quietly starve before epoch close.
